description: A general investment account statement, such as a brokerage statement, mutual-fund statement, or stock statement, showing the account holder, institution, and total portfolio value. Distinct from an IRA-specific account document.

account_holder_name.instruction: The full name of the individual who owns the investment account.

financial_institution.instruction: The name of the brokerage, fund company, or financial institution that manages the account.

document_type.instruction: The specific type of this investment document, normalized to exactly one of: Brokerage Statement, Mutual Fund Statement, or Stock Statement, based on the title or header text printed at the top of the document.

statement_period_start.instruction: Start of the statement period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

statement_period_end.instruction: End of the statement period. YYYY-MM-DD format.

total_value.instruction: The total account or portfolio value as of the end of the statement period.

asset_types.instruction: The types of assets held in the account, such as stocks, mutual funds, bonds, or ETFs. Return one entry per asset type listed.

interest_credits_cumulative.instruction: Total interest credited to the account during the statement period (cumulative).

dividend_payments_cumulative.instruction: Total dividend payments received during the statement period (cumulative).

capital_gains_distributions_cumulative.instruction: Total capital gains distributions received during the statement period (cumulative).
